property_summary: For any admissible input, a successful migrateTo transfers out the contract's ENTIRE Ether balance, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant only sends balances[creator], so whenever a non-creator depositor added Ether the buggy contract retains a nonzero balance.
change_summary: Transfer the creator's own balance mapping entry (in wei terms) instead of the contract's full balance, changing how much Ether is sent.
